about:
Fab Pigs operates from Fort Collins, Colorado, as a fabrication shop founded by Brandon and Matt. The business began with a focus on chopper-style motorcycles and custom fabrication, serving clients across Northern Colorado.

The shop provides precision machining, custom design, sanitary stainless steel fabrication, and residential fixture fabrication. It handles both small and large-scale projects, producing components for food processing, pharmaceutical, and healthcare equipment, as well as custom home features and chopper motorcycles. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

Customers come from food processing, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, residential construction, and motorcycle enthusiasts. The company fabricates hygienic stainless solutions for regulated industries and builds one-off residential fixtures and chopper bikes for individual buyers.

Fab Pigs emphasizes a blend of technical precision and artistic vision, citing exacting tolerances, collaborative client relationships from consultation through delivery, and a commitment to using high-quality materials. The founders describe their approach as pushing the boundaries of design and innovation while maintaining rigorous standards.
